mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate accommodative monetary policy and lower borrowing costs.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% for two consecutive months signals labor market deterioration, triggering immediate equity sell-offs due to reduced consumer spending confidence and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for two months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate revenue growth faces headwinds from reduced consumer activity.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth exceeding 1.5% year-over-year signals easing supply chain constraints, boosting corporate margins and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 1.5% YoY, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth above 2.5% indicates robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through accelerated corporate earnings growth and elevated business investment.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of quarters when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% triggers anticipated Federal Reserve tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to rising real interest rates and reduced equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in payroll employment and rising unemployment rate indicate labor market contraction, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending weakens and corporate hiring slows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Active monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS above 2.0%) cause negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced risk appetite as the Federal Reserve combats inflation.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
